os.name: Linux and OS
os.description: Namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, file systems and the process model. The foundation of every isolation technology and sandbox.
os.practice: Build a minimal container by hand with unshare and cgroups, limiting CPU, memory and network.

dist.name: Distributed Systems
dist.description: Long-running tasks, state recovery and scheduling are all distributed systems problems at heart.
concepts: Idempotency and the limits of exactly-once
dist.practice: Revisit the Raft lab from MIT 6.5840, focusing on how idempotency and retries are designed.

llm.name: LLM Fundamentals
llm.description: Building an agent platform means understanding the input and output constraints of the model.
llm.practice: Without a framework, call the API directly and implement one multi-turn tool-use exchange.

loop.name: Agent Loop
loop.description: The loop of model, tools and observations: the minimal core of every agent.
concepts: Returning tool errors to the model
loop.practice: Implement a complete agent loop with approval and interruption in under 200 lines.

iso.name: Isolation Technologies
iso.description: Security and performance trade-offs between containers, gVisor, Firecracker and Kata.
iso.practice: On one machine, compare the startup latency and syscall overhead of the three runtimes.

sandbox.name: Code Execution Sandbox
sandbox.description: The environment where agents write and run code, and the core product of agent infrastructure.
sandbox.practice: Build a code execution service with an API on top of Firecracker or gVisor.

sql-db.name: Relational Databases and SQL
sql-db.description: Transactions, indexes and query optimization: the state foundation of most backend services.
sql-db.practice: Design indexes for a table with tens of millions of rows and compare query plans and latency before and after.

cache.name: Caching
cache.description: Trade memory for latency and throughput while handling consistency and invalidation.
cache.practice: Add a Redis cache to a read-heavy endpoint and load-test its hit rate and P99.
